mcpOAuth.note: Paste https://www.unlinked.ai/mcp into a Claude or ChatGPT custom connector and sign in; each connection is a revocable account grant.

manualKeys.instructions: Manual key setup: https://www.unlinked.ai/agents. Lifecycle and release contract: docs/agent-key-settings.md in the repository.

data.ownerAiSearchRanking: Owner-network AI search requires supplied title/position evidence for a requested role, omits domain-only matches, and gives short conversational reasons grounded in supplied fields, stating when sector focus is unknown; response shapes and grant versions are unchanged.

mcp.grantVersioning: Manual-key controls and connector choice: docs/agent-key-settings.md. Historical-grant normalization, tool refresh and OAuth permission consent: docs/agent-api.md (repository).

privateNotesScope.oauthConsent: checkbox, starts ticked; connections made before catalog v7 reconnect
privateNotesScope.visibility: owner-only; shown in Unlinked and OpenChat; never notifies anyone; not a connection request; not messaging
privateNotesScope.messaging: OpenChat via the shared Ideaflow connector https://id.ideaflow.app/mcp (OpenChat permission); never an Unlinked key permission

agentHttpApi.grantProvisioning: POST /api/agent/v1/provision-grant — server-to-server, allow-listed confidential clients only (client_secret_basic), keyed on verified OIDC issuer+subject, never email; disabled unless operator-configured; contract v1.1 in docs/agent-api.md

connectionBrowsing.description: Page depth describes visible content, independently of membership. Only published connections are browsed.

publicWebSearch.scope: published professional People only; excludes private networks and contact details

alternateTransport.scope: same live canonical public page; no credentials forwarded or stored publication

messaging.agentCredential: Separate OpenChat oc_ key for messages and Context; Unlinked grants cannot send messages.

browserCardSharing.contactCardJoin: Explicit browser-only same-origin POST /c/<token>/add preserves the card through verified signup and adds the connection. Scanning alone does not connect. Not an agent capability.

requestDiagnostics.privacy: No credentials, queries, result bodies or sensitive URL parameters. Opaque account correlation only after successful authentication.
requestDiagnostics.gatewayLimitation: Shared gateway does not currently forward the downstream Unlinked request ID.
